name: todokeeper
description: Audit deferred-work files against the codebase before splitting, archiving, or choosing the next item.

interface.shortDescription: Audit deferred work against the codebase.
interface.longDescription: Measure deferred-work files, surface stale entries and dead referents, separate finished work from live work, and choose one evidence-backed next item without treating the backlog as a burn-down list.
defaultPrompt: What should I work on next from TODOS.md?
Check whether this TODO file is stale or too large.
